mapper.select: SELECT role_id, name, description, builtin, TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, TO_CHAR(update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time FROM app_role WHERE lower(name) = lower(#{name})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_role (role_id, name, description, builtin) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{builtin})
mapper.select: SELECT role_id, name, description, builtin, TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, TO_CHAR(update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time FROM app_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT r.role_id, r.name, r.description, r.builtin, TO_CHAR(r.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, TO_CHAR(r.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.role_id) AS account_count FROM app_role r ORDER BY r.create_time, r.role_id
SELECT count(*) FROM user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT permission_code FROM role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_permission (role_id, permission_code) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionCode}) ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_code) DO NOTHING
